evidence: Adds a GDB-based USDT test helper in test/functional/test_framework/usdt.py and refactors all USDT functional tests.
rationale: Replaces the complex BCC and eBPF toolchain with GDB to run USDT functional tests in unprivileged environments. According to the PR description, this eliminates host kernel header dependencies and root/BPF privileges while removing 'roughly 660 lines of test and CI code,' removing a substantial barrier to running USDT tests locally.
